Hi Claire —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers first: yes to acceptance code, yes we can support net60, and we can do weekly invoices but we recommend a weekly invoice + monthly reconciliation model for discounts. Details below: 

1) Acceptance code (6-digit)
- We can accept your acceptance token as a required invoice field. For our AP mapping we need that value also present in the PO under the "acceptance_code" custom field so our invoice processor can match automatically. I've attached an example CSV mapping for acceptance codes.

2) Net terms and discount gating
- Net60 is fine for baseline billing.
- Discount eligibility (your draft shows a volume-based rebate) requires a PO attribute to be set at onboarding called "pricing_bucket" (values: pilot, standard, enterprise). Without this attribute the system will not auto-apply the advanced slab discounts.
- To offer an early-pay discount we can propose a conditional option: 1.0% discount if HealthNest elects net30 on invoices we flag as "earlypay_eligible"; or 0.5% for net45. 

3) Invoice cadence options
- Option A: Weekly invoices (itemized) + monthly netting statement (recommended for reconciliation).
- Option B: Biweekly consolidated invoice (less AP overhead for you).
- Option C: Monthly statement only (default; slower cash visibility).

If you want the early-pay discount, finance needs a signed amendment that updates the PO "payment_term_override" and the "pricing_bucket" field. Attached: Discount_Sched_Sept2026.xlsx and Acceptance_Code_Mapping.csv as examples.

Next steps: if you confirm which cadence and whether you'll accept net30/net45 for partial discounts, I can loop in Accounting/Legal for the amendment and a DocuSign link.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
